answer.rationale: Current situation: p99 latency 5x target in primary region only, write-heavy settlement peak, security patch non-revertible. Memory_b2 demonstrates regional failover restored latency quickly (minutes) during March degradation with clean traffic shift. Memory_b3 shows provisioning headroom absorption of surge traffic. Rollback is constrained by compliance hold on security patch. Circuit breaker (memory_b4) is a dependency-level tool, not suitable for primary write path saturation. Read replica routing (memory_b5) addresses reporting load, not transactional write latency. Add capacity takes time we don't have at peak. Regional failover is the only intervention that can shed load from saturated primary immediately while preserving all writes (no data loss, compliance-compliant). Settlement traffic will shift to standby region; verified path from memory_b2. Preserves uncertainty by staging as standard experiment rather than broad rollout.
